def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Place by projected global KVPR, then improve with exact moves and swaps."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True):
        size, pressure = model.model_size, model.req_rate / model.slo
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best, best_score = None, float("inf")
        for gpu in range(gpu_num):
            if size > free[gpu]:
                continue
            remaining = free[gpu] - size
            projected = (load[gpu] + pressure) / remaining if remaining else float("inf")
            score = max(projected if i == gpu else ratios[i] for i in range(gpu_num))
            if score < best_score:
                best, best_score = gpu, score
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= size
        load[best] += pressure

    for _ in range(len(models)):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score, action = max(ratios), None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size, pressure = model.model_size, model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or size >= free[dst]:
                        continue
                    src_ratio = (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size)
                    dst_ratio = (load[dst] + pressure) / (free[dst] - size)
                    score = max(
                        src_ratio if i == src else dst_ratio if i == dst else ratios[i]
                        for i in range(gpu_num)
                    )
                    if score < best_score:
                        best_score, action = score, (src, dst, model, size, pressure)

        if action is None:
            break
        src, dst, model, size, pressure = action
        placement[src].remove(model)
        placement[dst].append(model)
        free[src] += size
        free[dst] -= size
        load[src] -= pressure
        load[dst] += pressure

    for _ in range(2):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score, action = max(ratios), None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for dst in range(src + 1, gpu_num):
                for left in placement[src]:
                    ls, lp = left.model_size, left.req_rate / left.slo
                    for right in placement[dst]:
                        rs, rp = right.model_size, right.req_rate / right.slo
                        src_free, dst_free = free[src] + ls - rs, free[dst] + rs - ls
                        if src_free <= 0 or dst_free <= 0:
                            continue
                        src_ratio = (load[src] - lp + rp) / src_free
                        dst_ratio = (load[dst] - rp + lp) / dst_free
                        score = max(
                            src_ratio if i == src else dst_ratio if i == dst else ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if score < best_score:
                            best_score, action = score, (src, dst, left, right, src_free, dst_free, lp, rp)

        if action is None:
            break
        src, dst, left, right, src_free, dst_free, lp, rp = action
        placement[src].remove(left)
        placement[dst].remove(right)
        placement[src].append(right)
        placement[dst].append(left)
        free[src], free[dst] = src_free, dst_free
        load[src] += rp - lp
        load[dst] += lp - rp

    return placement

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test the algorithm

GPU_MEM_SIZE = 80 # GB

def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Place large models first, then repeatedly choose the best improving move or swap."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True):
        best = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if model.model_size <= free[i]),
            key=lambda i: load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf"),
            default=None,
        )
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= model.model_size
        load[best] += model.req_rate / model.slo

    for _ in range(len(models) * 2):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        score, action = max(ratios), None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size, pressure = model.model_size, model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or size > free[dst]:
                        continue
                    remaining = free[dst] - size
                    candidate = max(
                        (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size) if i == src
                        else (load[dst] + pressure) / remaining if i == dst and remaining
                        else float("inf") if i == dst else ratios[i]
                        for i in range(gpu_num)
                    )
                    if candidate < score:
                        score, action = candidate, ("move", src, dst, model)

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for dst in range(src + 1, gpu_num):
                for a in placement[src]:
                    sa, pa = a.model_size, a.req_rate / a.slo
                    for b in placement[dst]:
                        sb, pb = b.model_size, b.req_rate / b.slo
                        fs, fd = free[src] + sa - sb, free[dst] + sb - sa
                        if fs < 0 or fd < 0:
                            continue
                        candidate = max(
                            (load[src] - pa + pb) / fs if i == src and fs
                            else (load[dst] - pb + pa) / fd if i == dst and fd
                            else float("inf") if i == src or i == dst else ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if candidate < score:
                            score, action = candidate, ("swap", src, dst, a, b)

        if action is None:
            break
        if action[0] == "move":
            _, src, dst, model = action
            placement[src].remove(model)
            placement[dst].append(model)
            free[src] += model.model_size
            free[dst] -= model.model_size
            pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
            load[src] -= pressure
            load[dst] += pressure
        else:
            _, src, dst, a, b = action
            placement[src].remove(a)
            placement[dst].remove(b)
            placement[src].append(b)
            placement[dst].append(a)
            free[src] += a.model_size - b.model_size
            free[dst] += b.model_size - a.model_size
            pa, pb = a.req_rate / a.slo, b.req_rate / b.slo
            load[src] += pb - pa
            load[dst] += pa - pb
